name: Startup India
summary: Government support for startups — tax benefits, easy registration, seed funding
hindi_summary: Naye business ke liye tax chhoot, aasan registration, aur seed fund
benefits: 3-year tax exemption, self-certification for compliance, ₹10 lakh seed fund, IPR fast-track
